body.p: The wood grouse cried, [he wants] to fly with the swans to where the swans go to spend the winter in warm [countries]. The wood grouse cried out to fly with the swans. The swan caused [lit. made] the wood grouse to cry out. And tied a strap to the wood grouse, the swan dragged the grouse. The grouse slowly flies, it cannot fly. The swan says: âGrouse, stay here! [If] we all fly, what will a human being eat when winter comes?â The grouse keeps crying. How can he stay without the swan?[StN]: progr[StN]: purp clauseShe [the swan] says: âGrouse, grouse! I'll take off your white wings [feathers?]!â The swan separated its wings from its armpit so that the grouse would stay. The grouse stayed. His eyes became red from crying. His eyes turned red from crying.
